Following the README's "Running locally" section, `npm run serve` fails with
"Missing script: serve". Is there another command I should be using?

args.body:
File: README.md

Replace `npm run serve` with `npm start` in the setup and run instructions in the README, matching the actual script defined in package.json.
args.title: Update README to use npm start instead of npm run serve

args.body:
label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

README.md tells users to run `npm run serve`, but package.json defines the start script as `start` ("node dist/index.js"), so `npm run serve` fails with "Missing script: serve".
